It serves as an authoritative one-stop guide for researchers and developers, continuously updated.

repos.description: https://getsurfboard.com
repos.summary_zh: Surfboard 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的自动化工具平台，支持网页爬虫、数据抓取与任务自动化。它提供直观的界面和强大的调度能力，帮助用户快速构建和部署 AI 驱动的自动化工作流，适用于内容聚合、数据收集等场景。
repos.summary_en: Surfboard is an automation platform designed for AI agents, enabling web scraping, data extraction, and task automation. It offers an intuitive interface and robust scheduling to help users build and deploy AI-driven workflows efficiently, ideal for content aggregation and data collection.

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo AI 影视 Studio 是首家工业级全流程可控协作式专业 AI 智能体影视生产平台，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色、场景并制作成完整视频，涵盖短片到漫剧再到真人级影视剧的全流程制作，采用好莱坞专业制作团队思路，提供虚拟制片场体验。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo AI Studio is the first industrial-grade, end-to-end controllable collaborative AI agent platform for professional film and TV production, supporting full-process creation from short films to anime series and feature films. It automatically generates storyboards, characters, and scenes from novel text and assembles them into complete videos, following Hollywood-level production workflows.

repos.description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
repos.summary_zh: Octop 是腾讯开源的自托管多用户 AI 助手，采用多 Agent 架构支持团队协作与个人使用。集成专家库、RAG 知识库、MCP/OAuth 连接器生态，支持 MBTI 人格模板、IDE 集成与浏览器自动化，JWT 隔离保障数据隐私本地化运行。
repos.summary_en: Octop is Tencent's open-source self-hosted multi-user AI assistant featuring a multi-agent architecture for team and personal collaboration. Integrates expert libraries, RAG knowledge base, MCP/OAuth connectors, MBTI personas, IDE integration and browser automation, with JWT isolation ensuring local privacy.

repos.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 是一款轻量跨平台本地网关工具，统一管理多种 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等）的模型选择与 API 路由。通过菜单栏应用、TUI 和 CLI 三种形态，无缝切换模型、共享订阅、自动同步实时模型目录，并精确编辑配置文件，实现多代理一站式编排。
repos.summary_en: Magpie is a lightweight cross-platform local gateway that centrally manages model selection and API routing for multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.). It offers menu-bar GUI, TUI and CLI interfaces, supports shared subscriptions, real-time model discovery, and surgical config editing for unified multi-agent orchestration.

repos.description: Automate your mobile devices with natural language commands - an LLM agnostic mobile Agent 🤖
repos.summary_zh: DroidRun 是一个强大的移动端自动化框架，通过 LLM 智能体实现自然语言控制 Android 和 iOS 设备。支持多模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic 等），具备复杂任务规划能力，提供 CLI 工具和 Python API，集成截图分析与执行追踪，实现高效移动端自动化。
repos.summary_en: DroidRun is a powerful framework for controlling Android and iOS devices via LLM agents using natural language commands. It supports multiple LLM providers, offers planning capabilities for complex tasks, includes a CLI tool with debugging features, and integrates screenshot analysis and execution tracing for mobile automation.

repos.description: Web dashboard for Hermes Agent — multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics
repos.summary_zh: Hermes Web UI 是一个功能完整的 Hermes Agent 管理仪表盘，支持多平台 AI 聊天会话管理、实时消息流、定时任务调度、使用量分析与成本追踪，以及 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等八种通信渠道的统一配置，提供本地 SQLite 会话存储与全局搜索能力。
repos.summary_en: Hermes Web UI is a full-featured dashboard for managing the Hermes Agent, offering multi-platform AI chat session control, real-time streaming, scheduled cron jobs, usage analytics with cost tracking, and unified configuration for 8 communication channels including Telegram, Discord, and Slack.

repos.description: A slide framework built for agents.
repos.summary_zh: open-slide 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的幻灯片框架，支持通过自然语言描述生成 React 幻灯片。提供 1920×1080 固定画布、热重载、演示模式、元素标注编辑、静态导出等功能，内置资产管理和品牌 Logo 搜索，适用于自动化生成高质量演示文稿。
repos.summary_en: open-slide is a slide framework designed for AI agents, enabling natural language-to-slide generation via React. It offers a fixed 1920×1080 canvas, hot reload, present mode, in-browser commenting, asset management with svgl logo search, and export to static HTML/PDF—ideal for automated, professional deck creation.

repos.description: 🪧 Claude Code / Codex skill — generate Xiaohongshu carousels & WeChat 21:9+1:1 cover pairs. Editorial × Swiss visual systems, 28 layouts, 10 themes, single-file HTML → PNG. 小红书图文 + 公众号封面对
repos.summary_zh: Guizang Social Card Skill 是一款面向 Claude Code / Codex 等 AI Agent 的图文卡片生成技能，专为小红书图文与公众号封面设计。内置 Editorial 与 Swiss 两套视觉系统，提供 28 种版式与 10 套主题，支持单文件 HTML 转 PNG，无需前端构建，自动适配多尺寸输出，集成图片搜索、地图组件与校验脚本，提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Guizang Social Card Skill is an AI agent skill for Claude Code/Codex that generates Xiaohongshu carousels and WeChat cover pairs. It features Editorial and Swiss visual systems with 28 layouts and 10 themes, converting single-file HTML to PNG without build tools. Includes image sourcing, map components, and validation scripts for streamlined social content creation.

repos.description: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文辅助创作系统，解决 AI 写作中的「遗忘」和「幻觉」问题，支持 200 万字量级 连载创作。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文创作辅助系统，通过双 Agent 架构和六维审查机制解决 AI 写作中的遗忘与幻觉问题，支持 200 万字级连载创作，集成 RAG 检索、创意约束系统和追读力机制，确保叙事连贯性与读者粘性。
repos.summary_en: A long-form webnovel writing assistant built on Claude Code, utilizing dual-agent architecture and six-dimensional review mechanisms to address AI writing issues like forgetting and hallucination, supporting serialized creation up to 2 million words with RAG retrieval, creative constraint systems, and reader engagement mechanics.

repos.summary_zh: Craft Agents 是一款基于 Agent Native 理念构建的开源桌面应用，支持通过自然语言连接任意 API、MCP 服务或本地工具（如 Slack、Linear、PostgreSQL），无需配置文件。它集成 Claude 与 Pi SDK，提供多会话管理、实时技能扩展和文档导向的工作流，所有操作均可通过提示词即时完成，专为高效人机协作设计。
repos.summary_en: Craft Agents is an open-source desktop application built on Agent Native principles, enabling natural language integration with any API, MCP server, or local tool (e.g., Slack, Linear, PostgreSQL) without config files. It combines Claude and Pi SDKs, offering multi-session management, real-time skill expansion, and a document-centric workflow—all customizable via prompts for seamless human-agent collaboration.

repos.description: ChatGPT thinks. Codex works. Use ChatGPT as the planning brain while keeping the Codex harness.
repos.summary_zh: 将 ChatGPT 网页版作为 Codex 编码会话的规划与审查大脑，执行权完全保留在 Codex。通过 OAuth 保护的只读 MCP 连接按需读取代码，仓库永不上传，无需 API Key 或逆向代理，充分利用付费订阅额度。
repos.summary_en: Uses the ChatGPT web app as the planning and review brain for Codex coding sessions, while Codex retains full execution control. Secure read-only MCP connection via OAuth reads only needed code; repo is never uploaded. No API key or reverse proxy required.

repos.description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop: Electron + Rust host core + pi Agent Harness + user-installable plugins
repos.summary_zh: PI-Desktop是一款本地优先的AI编程代理桌面应用，采用Electron + Rust架构。支持OpenAI、Anthropic及自定义模型，提供Agent/Plan/Goal三种协作模式，内置权限审查层与可扩展插件系统，实现跨平台独立编码工作空间。
repos.summary_en: PI-Desktop is a local-first AI coding agent desktop app built with Electron and Rust. It supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and custom models, offers Agent/Plan/Goal modes with permission controls and an extensible plugin system for cross-platform independent coding workspaces.

repos.description: A collection of MCP clients.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome MCP Clients 是一个精心策划的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 客户端集合，涵盖 CLI、桌面应用、AI 助手等多种类型，支持跨平台运行，旨在扩展 AI 模型对本地和远程资源的访问能力，提升智能交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Awesome MCP Clients is a curated collection of Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, including CLI tools, desktop apps, and AI assistants, supporting cross-platform use to extend AI models' access to local and remote resources for enhanced intelligent interaction.

repos.description: A multi-model AI agent desktop client — connect any AI provider, extend with MCP & skills, control from your phone. Built with Electron + Next.js.
repos.summary_zh: CodePilot 是一个基于 Electron + Next.js 构建的 Claude Code 桌面 GUI 客户端，提供多模型提供商支持、MCP 扩展、自定义技能、跨平台通信及项目感知型智能助手工作区，实现可视化聊天、编码与项目管理一体化体验。
repos.summary_en: CodePilot is a desktop GUI client for Claude Code built with Electron and Next.js, offering multi-provider support, MCP extensions, custom skills, cross-platform bridging, and an AI assistant workspace that understands your projects through persistent memory and onboarding flows.

repos.description: 🐬DeepChat - A smart assistant that connects powerful AI to your personal world
repos.summary_zh: DeepChat 是一个功能丰富的开源 AI 智能体平台，统一整合模型、工具和智能体，支持多 LLM 对话、MCP 工具调用和 ACP 智能体集成，提供强大的桌面端 AI 助手体验。
repos.summary_en: DeepChat is a powerful open-source AI agent platform that unifies models, tools, and agents, offering multi-LLM chat, MCP tool calling, and ACP agent integration for seamless desktop AI assistance.

repos.description: 达尔文.skill —— 一个让你的Skill无限进化的系统：评估→改进→测试→保留或回滚 | Autoresearch-inspired autonomous skill optimization for Claude Code. Evaluate, improve, test, keep or revert.
repos.summary_zh: 达尔文.skill 是一个受 autoresearch 启发的自主 Skill 优化系统，通过评估→改进→测试→保留/回滚的闭环循环，持续提升 Claude Code 等 Agent 工具的 Skill 性能。采用双重评估机制（结构质量+实际效果）和棘轮机制，确保每次修改只保留可测量的改进，支持 8 维度加权评分体系与人在回路验证。
repos.summary_en: Darwin.skill is an autonomous skill optimization system inspired by autoresearch, featuring a closed-loop cycle of evaluate-improve-test-keep/revert to continuously enhance agent skills in tools like Claude Code. It employs dual evaluation (structural quality + actual performance) and a ratchet mechanism to ensure only measurable improvements are retained, using an 8-dimensional weighted scoring system with human-in-the-loop validation.

repos.description: Zero-Config Code Flow for Claude code & Codex
repos.summary_zh: ZCF 是一款零配置 Claude Code & Codex 代码流工具，提供一键安装、双语界面、智能代理系统和个性化 AI 助手。支持多种 API 提供商（如 302.AI、GLM、PackyCode 等），内置工作流、MCP 集成，并持续更新维护，适合开发者快速部署 AI 编程环境。
repos.summary_en: ZCF (Zero-Config Code Flow) is a zero-configuration tool for Claude Code & Codex, enabling one-click setup with bilingual support, intelligent agent system, and personalized AI assistants. It supports multiple API providers (e.g., 302.AI, GLM, PackyCode), includes workflows and MCP integration, and is actively maintained for seamless AI coding experience.

repos.description: 多模型协作工作流引擎 — /ccg:go 一个命令，AI 自动分析意图、选择策略、编排 Codex + Gemini + Claude 协作执行
repos.summary_zh: CCG 是一个多模型协作开发系统，通过 Claude 编排 Codex（后端）与 Gemini（前端），提供 28 个命令覆盖完整开发流程。支持零配置路由、安全补丁审查及 OPSX 规范驱动开发，实现 AI 智能体协同编程。
repos.summary_en: CCG is a multi-model collaboration system where Claude orchestrates Codex (backend) and Gemini (frontend), offering 28 slash commands for full-stack development. Features zero-config routing, secure patch review, and OPSX-driven spec development for AI agent teamwork.

repos.description: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 智能体技能，支持 15+ 主流开发工具（如 Cursor、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）。通过中央仓库集中管理技能，支持从 Git 仓库、本地文件或市场导入，一键同步至目标工具，并提供场景分组、更新追踪和技能文档预览功能。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app that centralizes the management, sync, and organization of AI agent skills across 15+ coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot. It supports importing skills from Git repos, local folders, or the marketplace into a unified repository, enables one-click sync via symlinks/copies, and offers scenario grouping, update tracking, and in-app skill documentation preview.

repos.summary_zh: Craft Agents 是一款基于 Agent Native 理念构建的开源桌面应用，支持通过自然语言连接任意 API、MCP 服务或本地工具（如 Linear、Gmail、Slack、PostgreSQL 等），无需配置文件。它集成 Claude 与 Pi SDK，提供多会话管理、实时技能扩展和文档中心化工作流，用户仅需描述需求即可自动完成集成与任务执行。
repos.summary_en: Craft Agents is an open-source desktop application built on Agent Native principles, enabling natural language integration with any API, MCP service, or local tool (e.g., Linear, Gmail, Slack, PostgreSQL) without config files. It combines Claude and Pi SDKs to offer multi-session management, real-time skill expansion, and a document-centric workflow—users simply describe what they want, and the agent handles execution.

repos.description: ⚡️next-generation personal AI assistant powered by LLM, RAG and agent loops, supporting computer-use, browser-use and coding agent, demo: https://demo.openagentai.org
repos.summary_zh: OpenAgent 是一款开源的企业级 AI 知识库与智能体管理平台，支持 MCP/A2A 协议，集成 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama 等主流大模型，提供带单点登录的管理后台和用户界面，适用于构建私有化 AI 应用与多智能体协作系统。
repos.summary_en: OpenAgent is an open-source enterprise-grade AI knowledge base and agent management platform supporting MCP/A2A protocols. It integrates major LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, and Llama, offering admin UI, user management, and SSO for secure, scalable AI application deployment.

repos.description: The go-to web for your AI coding agent — local-first search, fetch, crawl & research over MCP. No API keys, no cloud, $0/query. Public beta.
repos.summary_zh: wigolo 是一款本地优先的 AI 智能体网页情报 MCP 服务器，为 AI 编程助手提供搜索、抓取、爬取及自主研究能力。它完全运行于本地（~/.wigolo/），无需 API 密钥或云服务，实现零成本查询，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流工具，是 AI 时代替代传统付费搜索 API 的隐私保护方案。
repos.summary_en: wigolo is a local-first MCP server delivering web intelligence for AI coding agents. It provides search, fetch, crawl, and autonomous research capabilities entirely on-device without API keys or cloud services. Supporting Claude Code, Cursor, and other major tools, it offers a privacy-focused, zero-cost alternative to metered search APIs.

repos.description: Kode CLI — Design for post-human workflows. One unit agent for every human & computer task.
repos.summary_zh: Kode CLI 是一款面向后人类工作流的终端 AI 编程助手，支持 AGENTS.md 标准，可自动理解代码库、编辑文件、执行命令并管理完整工作流。原生支持多平台与 20+ AI 模型，兼容 .claude 旧格式，具备子代理任务编排能力，适用于自动化编码与智能体协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Kode CLI is a terminal-based AI coding assistant designed for post-human workflows. It understands codebases, edits files, runs commands, and manages full development workflows. It natively supports the AGENTS.md standard, is compatible with 20+ AI models, and enables autonomous task orchestration via subagents.

repos.description: iFlow cli is a comprehensive command-line intelligence that embeds in your terminal, analyzes your repositories, does coding tasks, interprets your needs across contexts, and boosts efficiency by performing tasks from simple file operations to complex workflow automation.
repos.summary_zh: iFlow CLI 是一款终端内嵌的 AI 智能助手，支持自然语言交互、代码仓库分析、多模态输入及复杂工作流自动化。集成 iFlow 开放市场，一键安装 MCP 工具与子代理，提供免费版多模态模型（如 Kimi K2、Qwen3 Coder）支持，具备计划模式、任务压缩、插件扩展等高级功能，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: iFlow CLI is an AI-powered terminal assistant that analyzes codebases, executes coding tasks, and automates workflows via natural language. It integrates free multimodal models (e.g., Kimi K2, Qwen3 Coder), supports SubAgents and MCP tools from its Open Market, and offers advanced features like plan mode, context compression, and plugin support for enhanced developer productivity.

repos.description: Warcraft III Peon voice notifications (+ more!) for Claude Code, Codex, IDEs, and any AI agent. Stop babysitting your terminal. Employ a Peon today.
repos.summary_zh: peon-ping 是一款为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等）提供 Warcraft III 等游戏角色语音通知的开源工具，支持多平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/WSL2）。通过语音和屏幕横幅提醒开发者任务完成或需要交互，避免终端监控中断工作流，同时支持自定义音效包和 MCP 集成。
repos.summary_en: peon-ping is an open-source tool that delivers Warcraft III and other game character voice notifications to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It alerts users via audio and on-screen banners when tasks complete or require attention, eliminating constant terminal monitoring. Supports cross-platform use, custom sound packs, and MCP integration.

repos.description: Kode Agent — Design for post-human workflows. One unit agent for every human & computer task.
repos.summary_zh: Kode 是一个终端中的强大 AI 编程助手，支持 AGENTS.md 标准，可理解代码库、编辑文件、执行命令并自动化完整工作流程。它兼容 Claude 的 .claude 格式，提供 YOLO 模式（默认）和安全的权限检查模式，支持 20+ AI 模型，具备原生二进制分发能力，注重隐私且无默认遥测。
repos.summary_en: Kode is a powerful AI coding assistant in your terminal that understands codebases, edits files, runs commands, and automates workflows. It supports the AGENTS.md standard, is compatible with .claude formats, offers YOLO and safe modes, works with 20+ AI models, and features native binary distribution with privacy-first design and no telemetry by default.

repos.description: AI coding platform for teams
repos.summary_zh: MonkeyCode 是一款企业级 AI 编程助手，专为研发协作与管理场景设计，支持私有化部署与本地大模型接入，提供 IDE 对话式编程、代码补全、安全扫描及 Git 平台机器人能力，内置企业级管理面板用于审计管控与资源统一调度，兼顾效率与代码安全。
repos.summary_en: MonkeyCode is an enterprise-grade AI programming assistant designed for R&D collaboration and management. It supports private deployment, local LLM integration, and offline usage, offering IDE-based coding, intelligent completions, security scanning, Git platform bots, and a management panel for auditing, compliance, and centralized model usage control.

repos.description: Your agents don’t hand off the work. Kungfu keeps the same Work moving across Codex, Claude, OpenCode, and your own execution surface.
repos.summary_zh: Kungfu 是一款面向 AI 智能体的连续性保障框架，旨在解决会话结束后工作丢失的痛点。它通过声明式项目源管理上下文，使智能体在重启或切换时无需重复解释即可无缝续接任务，并保留完整的决策证据与行动边界。
repos.summary_en: Kungfu is a continuity framework for AI agents, designed to prevent work loss when chats end. It manages context from declared project sources, allowing agents to seamlessly resume tasks across restarts or handoffs without re-explaining, preserving decision evidence and action boundaries.

repos.description: ⚡️AI Cloud OS: Open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP (model-context-protocol)/A2A (agent-to-agent) management platform with admin UI, user management and Single-Sign-On⚡️, supports ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, HuggingFace, etc., chat bot demo: https://ai.casibase.com, admin UI demo: https://ai-admin.casibase.com
repos.summary_zh: Casibase 是一个开源企业级 AI 知识库与 MCP/A2A 管理平台，提供管理员界面、用户管理及单点登录功能，支持 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama、Ollama 等多种模型，具备完整的知识库管理、智能对话和 Agent 协作能力。
repos.summary_en: Casibase is an open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP/A2A management platform featuring admin UI, user management, and SSO, supporting ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, and more, with full knowledge management and agent collaboration capabilities.

repos.description: Run Claude Design locally as an Agent Skill — Cursor, Claude Code & more. Produce polished UI mockups, prototypes, decks & wireframes as self-contained HTML, without claude.ai/design. Best with Opus or Claude.
repos.summary_zh: baoyu-design 将 Claude Design 设计引擎封装为本地 Agent Skill，可在 Cursor、Claude Code 等编码 Agent 中直接生成高质量 UI 原型、线框图、落地页、仪表盘和演示文稿，输出为自包含 HTML。无需访问 claude.ai/design 网站，支持 Opus 4.8 获得最佳效果，通过 localhost 预览实现可视化迭代编辑。
repos.summary_en: baoyu-design packages the Claude Design engine as a portable Agent Skill, enabling local coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code to generate polished UI mockups, prototypes, wireframes, landing pages, dashboards, and slide decks as self-contained HTML. No website or subscription needed—everything runs locally with tight visual iteration via localhost preview, best paired with Opus 4.8.

repos.description: High-crafted UI libraries for AI agents: Border beam, Orbs, Metal, Gooey, Voice, Image, Avatar bots
repos.summary_zh: 专为 AI 智能体打造的高品质 React UI 特效库集合，包含 border-beam 动态边框光束、liquid-gooey 液态流体效果和 thinking-orbs 点阵加载动画。支持 React Native 与 SwiftUI 跨平台复用，采用 npm workspaces 多包管理，提供可视化演示站点与 CI 自动化发布流程。
repos.summary_en: High-quality React UI effect libraries tailored for AI agents, featuring animated border beams, liquid morph effects, and dotted orb loaders. Supports cross-platform React Native and SwiftUI ports. Built with npm workspaces for multi-package management, including hot-reload development and automated CI deployment.

repos.description: 让 AI 写的中文读起来像一个具体的人在说话。通用创作与改稿 Skill，开箱即用。
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 写的中文摆脱模型腔，读起来像具体的人在说话。提供开箱即用的写作 Skill，覆盖知乎、公众号、博客、小说等多种场景，内置事实核查、逻辑推进与中文韵律三重把关，附检测脚本与蒸馏版提示词。
repos.summary_en: Eliminates AI-generated Chinese stiffness, making outputs read like a real person speaking. Provides a ready-to-use writing Skill for Zhihu, WeChat articles, blogs, fiction and more, with built-in fact-checking, logical progression and Chinese rhythm controls, plus a detection script and distilled prompt version.

repos.description: Chrome extension & CLI to let agents control your browser. Runs Playwright snippets in a stateful sandbox. Available as CLI or MCP
repos.summary_zh: Playwriter 是一款 Chrome 扩展工具，允许 AI 智能体通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议控制用户浏览器。它直接连接已登录的 Chrome 实例，保留用户会话状态（如 cookies、扩展），避免新建浏览器带来的安全风险和检测问题。核心功能包括 Playwright API 调用、多会话隔离、网络请求拦截、页面调试编辑等，适用于自动化测试、数据采集和智能体交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwriter is a Chrome extension enabling AI agents to control your browser via CLI or MCP. It connects directly to your running Chrome instance, preserving logins, extensions, and cookies—avoiding the security risks and detection issues of spawning new browsers. Key features include full Playwright API access, isolated sessions, network interception, page debugging, and live code editing for automation, testing, and agent-driven workflows.

repos.description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.
repos.summary_zh: gzh-design-skill 是一款专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版工具，能将 Markdown 一键转换为可直接粘贴进微信公众号编辑器的精致 HTML。它提供 6 套精选主题及自定义主题生成器，通过全内联样式与特定标签规避平台过滤，并具备章节编号、关键词标记及双关卡质量校验功能，确保排版的高保真与一致性。
repos.summary_en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready WeChat Official Account HTML. It features 6 preset themes and a custom theme generator, utilizing inline styles and specific tags to bypass platform filters. With auto-numbering, keyword marking, and dual-stage quality validation, it ensures high-fidelity, consistent formatting for content creators.

repos.description: WeChat local data CLI with daemon architecture
repos.summary_zh: wx-cli 是一款基于 Rust 开发的本地微信数据命令行工具，支持会话、聊天记录、联系人、群成员、收藏、朋友圈等数据的毫秒级查询与导出。采用守护进程架构实现高效缓存，零依赖安装，支持 YAML/JSON 输出，专为 AI Agent 和开发者设计，数据完全本地化处理，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: wx-cli is a Rust-based CLI tool for querying local WeChat data, including chats, contacts, groups, favorites, and Moments. It features a daemon architecture for millisecond-level response, zero-dependency installation, YAML/JSON output, and full local data processing, making it ideal for AI agents and developers.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg是一款协作式多智能体AI编码工作空间，统一整合Claude Code、Codex、Grok等15+主流AI编程代理。提供桌面应用、自托管服务及Docker部署方案，支持跨平台使用。核心特性包括会话跨代理迁移、任务委托协作、统一对话界面，大幅降低多代理协作门槛。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace unifying 15+ AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Grok. Supports desktop, self-hosted, and Docker deployments across all platforms. Key features include session migration between agents, collaborative task delegation via @mentions, and a unified conversation interface.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是一个企业级多智能体编码工作台，统一集成 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等本地 AI 编程助手。支持桌面应用、独立服务器或 Docker 部署，提供浏览器远程访问。核心功能包括对话聚合、Git worktree 并行开发、MCP/Skills 管理、Telegram/Lark 等聊天渠道集成及终端集成，实现全链路工程化开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace that unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container. It enables remote development via any browser with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree workflows, MCP/Skills management, chat channel integration (Telegram, Lark, iLink), and integrated terminal/file/Git workflows.

repos.description: A plugin for AI coding agents (Antigravity, Claude Code) enabling Spec-Driven Development to specify, plan, and implement software features.
repos.summary_zh: Conductor 是 Gemini CLI 的扩展工具，通过上下文驱动开发（Context-Driven Development）实现软件功能的规范化生命周期管理。它支持在编码前制定详细规格与执行计划，确保代码质量与团队一致性，适用于新项目和现有项目的智能开发流程管控。
repos.summary_en: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension enabling Context-Driven Development by managing the full lifecycle of software features—from context setup, spec/plan generation, to safe implementation. It ensures high-quality, team-aligned development with intelligent planning and git-aware reverts.

repos.description: 面向 AI Agent 的微信公众号创作与发布 CLI：Markdown 排版、AI 配图、预览与草稿创建；支持由浏览器 Agent 保存知乎、CSDN、头条未发布草稿。
repos.summary_zh: md2wechat 是一款专为 AI 时代设计的公众号创作工具，支持用 Markdown 编写文章并一键转换为精美排版，自动上传至微信草稿箱。提供 43 个高级排版模块、40+ 专业主题、AI 配图及批量发布功能，全流程 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code 等智能体，让公众号写作高效如发朋友圈。
repos.summary_en: md2wechat is an AI-native WeChat article creation tool that converts Markdown into beautifully formatted posts and auto-uploads to the draft box. It offers 43 advanced layout modules, 40+ professional themes, AI image generation, and batch publishing via CLI, with native support for agents like Claude Code.

repos.description: Remote Control for Codex.
repos.summary_zh: Remodex 是一款本地优先的开源桥接工具，结合 iOS 应用与 macOS 后台服务，实现 iPhone 对 OpenAI Codex 的远程控制。支持端到端加密配对、实时流式交互、Git 操作、子智能体调用及结构化规划模式，提供低延迟响应与细粒度访问控制，全程无需依赖公共服务器。
repos.summary_en: Remodex is a local-first open-source bridge with an iOS app that enables remote control of OpenAI Codex from your iPhone. It features end-to-end encrypted pairing, real-time streaming, Git actions, subagents, planning mode, and secure access controls—all running on-device without relying on public endpoints.

repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是冬瓜关于 Pi-Agent SDK 的深度学习笔记，系统拆解了生产级 AI Agent 运行时的核心架构。教程涵盖 Agent Loop、工具系统、事件驱动等 10 大模块，通过 TypeScript 与 Python 双语言对照，深入剖析了 Agent SDK 的设计取舍与源码实现，适合希望构建或理解 Agent 底层逻辑的开发者。
repos.summary_en: A deep-dive tutorial repository on the Pi-Agent SDK, systematically deconstructing the core architecture of production-grade AI Agent runtimes. Covering 10 modules including Agent Loop, tool systems, and event-driven design, it provides TypeScript and Python dual-language comparisons to analyze the source code and design trade-offs of Agent SDKs for developers.

repos.description: The simplest desktop client for OpenClaw 🦞 — bridge your Agent to WeChat, Feishu, Slack & Discord in one click. Works with Claude Code, Codex & any LLM. BYOK, Oauth, local-first, chat from your phone 24/7.
repos.summary_zh: nexu 是一款开源桌面客户端，专为 OpenClaw 🦞 设计，一键桥接 Agent 到微信、飞书、Slack 和 Discord。支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 LLM，采用 BYOK（自带密钥）、OAuth 认证及本地优先架构，实现全天候手机聊天。所有数据本地存储，隐私可控，提供图形化安装与多模型切换功能。
repos.summary_en: nexu is an open-source desktop client for OpenClaw 🦞 that bridges your AI agent to WeChat, Feishu, Slack, and Discord with one click. It works with Claude Code, Codex, and any LLM via BYOK, OAuth, and local-first architecture. Chat from your phone 24/7 with full privacy control—no vendor data routing. Features GUI setup, multi-model support (e.g., Gemini), and built-in IM integrations.

repos.description: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
repos.summary_zh: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一款面向智能体开发的跨平台桌面应用，将终端、代码编辑器和上下文文件整合在无限画布中，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。基于 Electron 40、React 19 和 Tailwind CSS 4 构建，集成 Monaco 编辑器、xterm.js 终端和 D3 可视化，实现本地优先、无账号的协作开发环境，消除上下文切换，提升智能体协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a cross-platform desktop environment for agentic development, unifying terminals, code editors, and context files on an infinite canvas. Built with Electron 40, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4, it integrates Monaco Editor, xterm.js terminal, and D3 visualization. Designed for local-first, account-free workflows, it eliminates context switching and enhances agent collaboration across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: README file generator, powered by AI.
repos.summary_zh: ReadmeAI 是一款基于 AI 的 README 文件自动生成工具，支持通过代码仓库 URL 或本地路径一键生成结构化、详细的文档。支持 OpenAI、Ollama、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种 LLM 模型，具备智能文件过滤、离线模式运行、高度可定制化模板与样式等功能，旨在提升开发者文档编写效率。
repos.summary_en: ReadmeAI is an AI-powered tool that automatically generates high-quality README files from code repositories. It supports multiple LLM backends (OpenAI, Ollama, Anthropic, Gemini), offers customizable templates, intelligent file filtering via .readmeaiignore, and works offline. Designed to boost developer productivity and ensure consistent documentation across projects.

repos.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
repos.summary_zh: Cindy 是一款开源、开箱即用的跨平台 AI Agent 客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex 等多种模型编排。它可在本地运行，集成文件系统访问、浏览器自动化和 MCP 协议，实现跨设备的任务编排与自动化执行。
repos.summary_en: Cindy is an open-source, out-of-the-box AI agent client supporting Claude Code and Codex orchestration. It runs locally with file system access, browser automation, and MCP protocol integration for cross-device task orchestration and automated execution.

repos.description: Bridge Claude Code / Codex to IM platforms — chat with AI coding agents from Telegram, Discord, or Feishu/Lark.
repos.summary_zh: Claude-to-IM Skill 是一个轻量级 CLI 工具，将 Claude Code / Codex 与 Telegram、Discord、飞书/Lark 或 QQ 等即时通讯平台桥接，实现通过 IM 聊天与 AI 编程代理交互。支持权限控制、流式响应预览、会话持久化，无需编码即可快速部署。
repos.summary_en: Claude-to-IM Skill is a lightweight CLI tool that bridges Claude Code/Codex with IM platforms like Telegram, Discord, Feishu/Lark, and QQ. It enables chatting with AI coding agents directly from your chats, featuring permission control, streaming previews, session persistence, and zero-code setup.

repos.description: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为高权限自主AI代理OpenClaw设计，采用‘代理式零信任架构’范式，从传统静态防御转向动态防护。通过三层防御矩阵（事前行为黑名单、事中权限限制、事后夜间审计）有效应对提示注入、供应链投毒等AI特有风险，支持强推理模型自动部署，显著降低用户配置成本。
repos.summary_en: This guide is tailored for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional static defense to 'Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture'. It implements a battle-tested 3-Tier Defense Matrix—pre-action blacklists, in-action permission controls, and post-action nightly audits—to mitigate LLM-specific threats like prompt injection and supply chain poisoning. Designed for seamless integration with strong reasoning models to minimize manual security setup.

repos.description: YAO = Yielding AI Outcomes. A rigorous engineering, evaluation, governance, and portability system for reusable agent skills.
repos.summary_zh: YAO是AI智能体技能的可复用工程与治理系统，将重复工作流打包为跨平台技能包。2.0升级为Skill OS，提供技能IR中间表示、目标编译器、评估证据库、发布门禁和技能生命周期治理，实现从创建到迭代的完整闭环。
repos.summary_en: YAO is a rigorous engineering and governance system for reusable AI agent skills. Version 2.0 upgrades to a Skill OS with platform-neutral IR, target compilers, evaluation evidence lab, release gates, and full lifecycle governance — turning repeated workflows into installable, cross-platform skill packages.

repos.description: 一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每天自动抓取 Hacker News 热门文章，通过 AI 生成中文总结并转换为播客内容。
repos.summary_zh: Agili 的 Hacker Podcast 是一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每日自动抓取热门文章，利用 AI 生成中文摘要并转换为语音播客。项目采用 Cloudflare Workers 部署，结合 OpenAI API 与 TTS 技术，支持多平台订阅，实现技术资讯的自动化聚合与分发。
repos.summary_en: Agili's Hacker Podcast is an AI-powered Chinese podcast project that automatically fetches daily top articles from Hacker News, generates Chinese summaries via AI, and converts them into audio content. Built with Cloudflare Workers, OpenAI API, and TTS, it supports multi-platform RSS and web access for automated tech news aggregation.

repos.description: Provider-neutral Codex Skill for producing verified AI presenter videos from a script and an authorized presenter image.
repos.summary_zh: Provider-neutral的Codex Skill，将脚本与授权肖像转化为AI演示者视频。支持9种视觉风格、运行时动态选择AI提供商、音频锁定时间线确保口型同步，内置成本防护与验证交付流程，适配Claude Code、Cursor等多Agent平台。
repos.summary_en: Provider-neutral Agent Skill for producing verified AI presenter videos from scripts. Supports 9 visual styles, dynamic provider selection at runtime, audio-locked timeline for lip-sync accuracy, cost guardrails, and evidence-gated QA. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agent platforms.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一个专为 AI 智能体协作设计的 macOS 桌面应用，提供无限画布环境，集成终端、代码编辑器和文件管理功能。支持多工作区、实时终端交互和拖拽式文件操作，采用 Electron + React 技术栈，所有数据本地存储，适用于端到端的智能体开发流程。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a macOS-native desktop app for building with AI agents, featuring an infinite canvas workspace with integrated terminals, code editors, and file navigation. It supports multi-workspace management, real-time agent interaction, and local data storage, built on Electron, React, and xterm.js for seamless agentic development.

repos.summary_zh: 基于多智能体协同与LLM增强的AI投资决策系统，集成多头/空头研究员、辩论室机制和宏观分析，通过智能新闻搜索与缓存优化实现自动化投资建议生成，支持Gemini/OpenAI兼容模型，适用于AI与金融交叉领域研究。
repos.summary_en: An AI investment system leveraging multi-agent collaboration and LLM-enhanced decision-making, featuring bull/bear researchers, debate room mechanisms, and macro analysis. It integrates intelligent news search with caching optimization for automated investment recommendations, supporting Gemini/OpenAI-compatible models for AI-finance research applications.

repos.description: worktree coding agents command center.
repos.summary_zh: Supacode 是一个原生终端编码智能体指挥中心，专为 macOS 设计。它采用 Swift Composable Architecture 构建，集成 libghostty 实现高性能终端交互，支持通过 mise 管理依赖，提供完整的开发、测试与格式化工具链，致力于提升终端环境下的 AI 辅助编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Supacode is a native terminal coding agent command center for macOS, built with Swift Composable Architecture and integrated with libghostty for high-performance terminal interaction. It supports dependency management via mise and offers a full development workflow including build, test, and formatting tools, focusing on enhancing AI-assisted programming in the terminal environment.

repos.description: ClawGod is a runtime patch applied to the official Claude Code. It continues to be supported with each version update.
repos.summary_zh: ClawGod 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的运行时补丁工具，通过动态注入方式解锁官方版本限制的功能，包括隐藏命令、多智能体协作、屏幕控制等。支持跨平台自动更新与卸载，绿色图标标识已打补丁状态，显著提升开发效率与功能自由度。
repos.summary_en: ClawGod is a runtime patch for Claude Code that unlocks restricted features like hidden commands, multi-agent collaboration, and computer use without Pro subscription. It auto-reapplies patches after updates, uses green branding to indicate patched status, and supports cross-platform installation with one-line scripts.

repos.description: Your AI agent skills, finally organized. A macOS app to browse, edit, and manage skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and Amp.
repos.summary_zh: Chops 是一款 macOS 原生应用，专为统一管理和编辑 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf、Amp 等 AI 编程工具的代码技能而设计。支持实时文件监控、全文搜索、集合分类和远程技能库连接，提供 SwiftUI + SwiftData 架构下的流畅编辑体验。
repos.summary_en: Chops is a native macOS app that centralizes management of AI coding agent skills across tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It features real-time file watching, full-text search, collections, and remote skill server integration, built with SwiftUI and SwiftData for seamless editing.

repos.description: Connect to any agents with WeChat ClawBot.
repos.summary_zh: WeClaw 是一个 WeChat AI Agent 桥接工具，支持连接 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等主流 AI 模型。通过 QR 码登录微信后自动检测并集成已安装的 AI 代理，提供 ACP/CLI/HTTP 三种交互模式，支持消息转发、图片文件传输、Markdown 转换及主动推送功能，具备持久化配置和命令行/API 双重控制能力。
repos.summary_en: WeClaw is a WeChat AI Agent Bridge that connects WeChat to AI agents like Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It auto-detects installed agents via QR login, supports ACP/CLI/HTTP modes, handles media/image forwarding, converts markdown responses, and enables proactive messaging via CLI or HTTP API with persistent config.

repos.description: MultiAgentPPT 是一个集成了 A2A（Agent2Agent）+ MCP（Model Context Protocol）+ ADK（Agent Development Kit） 架构的智能化演示文稿生成系统，支持通过多智能体协作和流式并发机制
repos.summary_zh: MultiAgentPPT 是基于 A2A+MCP+ADK 架构的多智能体演示文稿生成系统，通过大纲生成、主题拆分、并行调研和流式汇总等智能体协作，实现高质量PPT的自动化生成，支持实时编辑与下载，具备可扩展性和本地模型适配能力。
repos.summary_en: MultiAgentPPT is a multi-agent system leveraging A2A+MCP+ADK architecture to automate PPT generation through outline creation, topic splitting, parallel research, and streaming synthesis. It supports real-time editing, high-quality content, extensibility, and local model compatibility.

repos.description: Let your AI agent get the sources behind logins and paywalls.
repos.summary_zh: Actionbook 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的浏览器操作引擎，提供实时更新的网页操作手册和 DOM 结构信息，使智能体能快速、精准地执行网页交互任务。相比传统方法，其性能提升 10 倍，显著降低 LLM 的 token 消耗，并通过语义化 JSON 定义实现高容错性和跨框架兼容性。
repos.summary_en: Actionbook is a browser action engine designed for AI agents, delivering up-to-date action manuals and DOM structure so agents can instantly operate any website without guessing. It enables 10x faster execution, 100x token savings, resilient automation via versioned manuals, and universal compatibility with any LLM or agent framework.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款开源免费的 macOS 原生系统管理工具，集垃圾清理、应用卸载、磁盘分析、重复文件查找和实时状态监控于一体。内置 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 代理安全可控地监控和维护 Mac，所有操作可审计、可回滚。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS system management tool that combines junk cleanup, app uninstallation, disk analysis, duplicate finding, and live status monitoring. It features a built-in MCP server for AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor to safely monitor and maintain your Mac, with all actions consent-gated, audited, and reversible.

repos.description: Boss直聘爬虫 / BOSS直聘职位数据抓取工具，基于 Chrome CDP 协议复用真实登录态，绕过字体反爬，输出明文薪资 JSON/CSV + 薪资技能分析。A Chrome-CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper/crawler.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Chrome CDP 协议的 BOSS直聘职位抓取工具，通过复用本地真实登录态调用官方搜索 API，有效绕过前端字体反爬机制，直接获取明文薪资数据。支持 JSON/CSV 双格式输出，并提供薪资分布、技能词频分析及求职材料优化提示词生成，可作为 CLI 工具或 Hermes Agent Skill 使用。
repos.summary_en: A Chrome CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper that leverages local authenticated sessions to invoke official search APIs, effectively bypassing font anti-scraping to extract plain-text salary data. It supports JSON/CSV output and provides salary distribution analysis, skill frequency statistics, and job application prompt generation, usable as both a CLI tool and a Hermes Agent Skill.

repos.description: Desktop Agent for Any Task
repos.summary_zh: WorkAny 是一款桌面 AI 智能体应用，通过自然语言指令执行复杂任务，支持实时代码生成、工具调用和沙箱环境运行。基于 Claude Agent SDK 构建，集成 MCP 协议与多模型供应商，提供文件管理、文档/网页/表格/幻灯片生成等全场景能力，适用于自动化办公与软件开发。
repos.summary_en: WorkAny is a desktop AI agent that executes tasks via natural language, featuring real-time code generation, sandboxed execution, and workspace management. Built on Claude Agent SDK with MCP support and multi-provider LLM integration, it enables automated file organization, document/web/table/slide generation, and software development workflows.

repos.description: A Python library that provides an easy way to identify devices like mobile phones, tablets and their capabilities by parsing (browser) user agent strings.
repos.summary_zh: user_agents 是一个 Python 库，用于解析浏览器 User-Agent 字符串，精准识别设备类型（手机、平板、PC）及其功能特性（如触屏能力），支持主流移动平台与爬虫检测，依赖 ua-parser 实现高效解析。
repos.summary_en: user_agents is a Python library that parses browser User-Agent strings to accurately identify device types (mobile, tablet, PC) and capabilities (e.g., touch support), supporting major platforms and bot detection via the ua-parser engine.

repos.description: Full-stack AI agent for coding, files, terminals, tools, research, content, multimodal work, and multi-agent workflows.
repos.summary_zh: ProxyCast 是一款基于 Tauri 的本地优先 AI Agent 创作工作台，整合 Workspace、Skills、MCP 标准能力与 Claw 渠道协作，实现从灵感到可发布内容的闭环流程。支持文档生成、研究整理、多平台异步协作及浏览器/终端扩展执行，适合创作者与知识工作者高效沉淀可复用资产。
repos.summary_en: ProxyCast is a local-first AI Agent workspace built with Tauri, integrating Workspace, Skills, MCP-standardized capabilities, and Claw channel collaboration to close the loop from idea to publishable content. It supports document generation, research organization, cross-platform async workflows, and browser/terminal extensions, ideal for creators and knowledge workers to streamline reusable output.

repos.description: Yet another reusable writing skill for Chinese technical documentation and product copy.
repos.summary_zh: 面向中文技术文档与产品文案的写作 Skill，帮助 AI 助手（Codex、Claude Code）生成克制、准确、易读的中文技术内容。解决空泛表达、机械直译、中英混排可读性差等问题，覆盖接口文档、落地页、FAQ 等高频场景。
repos.summary_en: A reusable writing skill for Chinese technical documentation and product copy. Helps AI agents (Codex, Claude Code) generate precise, readable Chinese tech content. Solves issues like empty rhetoric, mechanical translations, and mixed Chinese-English typography. Covers API docs, landing pages, and FAQs.

repos.description: 中文手绘技术 PPT 整页图像生成 Skill | 21:9 封面 + 16:9 正文配图 | PNG 输出
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个 Codex Skill，用于将文章、课程笔记等内容转化为风格统一的中文手绘技术解释图。支持生成 21:9 封面与 16:9 正文 PNG 图像，强调内容叙事规划与视觉一致性，适用于技术文章配图、课件制作和知识卡片生成，推荐使用 ChatGPT Image 2.0 模型以保证输出质量。
repos.summary_en: This Codex Skill transforms articles, course notes, or outlines into stylistically consistent Chinese hand-drawn technical illustration images. It generates 21:9 cover images and 16:9 content pages in PNG format, emphasizing narrative planning and visual coherence. Ideal for technical articles, courseware, and knowledge cards, it recommends ChatGPT Image 2.0 for optimal output quality.

repos.description: Fast, context-efficient repository tools for AI agents (MCP)
repos.summary_zh: FastCtx 是一款基于 Rust 的高性能本地工具运行时，专为 AI 编程智能体设计，通过 MCP 协议提供文件读取、内容搜索、文件发现、批量替换及 Bash 命令执行等结构化仓库操作。它将复杂的 Shell 命令封装为稳定的输入输出模型，显著降低 AI 代理在工具调用上的认知负担，提升上下文效率，使模型能更专注于代码理解与任务规划。
repos.summary_en: FastCtx is a high-performance Rust-based local tool runtime designed for AI coding agents, providing structured repository operations like file reading, content search, file discovery, batch replacement, and Bash execution via MCP. It encapsulates complex shell commands into stable I/O models, significantly reducing the cognitive load on AI agents, improving context efficiency, and allowing models to focus more on code comprehension and task planning.

repos.description: All your AI agent sessions in one place — browse, search, resume. Rust + GPUI.
repos.summary_zh: Wake是一款基于Rust+GPUI的macOS原生应用，聚合Claude、Codex、Copilot、Cursor等多个AI编程代理的会话记录。支持全文搜索（FTS5）、会话一键恢复、本地隐私保护（零网络请求），统一浏览所有编码助手历史。
repos.summary_en: Wake is a native macOS app built with Rust + GPUI that unifies all coding-agent sessions — Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and more. Features full-text search (FTS5), one-click resume, local-first privacy (zero network), and incremental real-time scanning.

repos.description: BrowserWing turns your browser actions into MCP commands Or Claude Skill, allowing AI agents to control browsers efficiently and reliably. Say goodbye to slow, token-heavy LLM interactions — let agents call commands directly for faster automation. Perfect for AI-driven tasks, browser automation, and boosting productivity.
repos.summary_zh: BrowserWing 是一款原生浏览器自动化平台，支持通过 MCP 协议和 Claude Skill 让 AI 智能体直接控制浏览器。提供 26+ HTTP API 接口、可视化脚本录制、LLM 驱动的数据提取及会话管理，实现高效可靠的浏览器自动化，显著减少 LLM 交互延迟。
repos.summary_en: BrowserWing is a native browser automation platform that enables AI agents to control browsers via MCP commands or Claude Skills. It offers 26+ HTTP APIs, visual script recording, LLM-powered data extraction, and session management for fast, reliable automation with minimal token overhead.

repos.description: Skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving icons
repos.summary_zh: Better Icons 是一个图标搜索与检索工具，提供20万+图标资源，支持150+主流图标库（如 Lucide、Heroicons）。可作为 MCP 服务器集成到 AI 编程助手（Cursor/Claude等），或作为 CLI 工具直接调用。具备智能学习、批量获取、跨框架导出等功能，显著提升开发者在 AI 辅助编码中的图标使用效率。
repos.summary_en: Better Icons is a skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving over 200,000 icons from 150+ collections (e.g., Lucide, Heroicons). It integrates with AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code via MCP, or functions as a CLI tool. Features include auto-learning usage patterns, batch retrieval, multi-framework exports (React/Vue/Svelte), and direct SVG output to save tokens in AI chats.

repos.description: Claude Code 中文开发套件 - 为中国开发者定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境。一键安装完整中文化体验，集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描，支持免翻墙访问。让 AI 编程更简单。
repos.summary_zh: Claude Code 中文开发套件是为中国开发者量身定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境，提供一键安装的全中文化体验。集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描等核心功能，支持免翻墙访问。最新版本融合 Anthropic 黑客松冠军配置，包含 9 个专用智能体、7+ 技能模块、10 个快捷指令和完整规则体系，实现从需求分析到代码审查的全流程 AI 驱动开发。
repos.summary_en: Claude Code Chinese Development Kit is a zero-threshold AI programming environment tailored for Chinese developers, offering one-click installation with full Chinese localization. It integrates MCP servers, intelligent context management, security scanning, and supports direct access without VPN. The latest version incorporates the Anthropic Hackathon-winning configuration, featuring 9 specialized agents, 7+ skill modules, 10 slash commands, and a complete rule system for end-to-end AI-driven development workflows.

repos.description: A dev environment for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Jean 是一款基于 Tauri v2 的桌面 AI 助手应用，专为多项目管理、git worktree 自动化及 Claude/Codex/OpenCode CLI 集成设计。支持会话管理、AI 编程助手（含思维链与 MCP 支持）、GitHub 问题追踪、终端集成及远程 Web 访问，提供本地化的无厂商锁定开发体验。
repos.summary_en: Jean is a desktop AI assistant built with Tauri v2, designed for managing multiple projects, git worktrees, and integrating Claude CLI, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. It offers session management, AI-powered development workflows (with thinking modes and MCP support), GitHub integration, terminal access, and remote web access—all running locally without vendor lock-in.

repos.description: 把灵感、写作、出图、改稿、沉淀放进同一个工作台，让创作从“想到”直接走到“可发布”
repos.summary_zh: ProxyCast 是一个面向创作者的 AI Agent 平台，整合灵感发散、内容生成、素材制作与版本沉淀全流程，支持社媒、短视频、小说、海报等九大创作主题，实现从想法到可发布内容的一站式高效创作。
repos.summary_en: ProxyCast is an AI Agent platform for creators, integrating ideation, content generation, asset creation, and versioning into a unified workspace. It supports nine major creative domains—from social media to novels—enabling seamless workflows from concept to publishable output.

repos.description: A free, elegant Markdown editor for macOS, Windows and Linux. Simple by design, always in sync with the file on disk.
repos.summary_zh: ColaMD 是一款专为 AI 智能体协作设计的原生 Markdown 编辑器，支持实时同步 AI 对 .md 文件的修改，具备 WYSIWYG 编辑、多主题支持和跨平台导出功能。其核心亮点在于通过文件监听实现 AI 操作的无缝可视化，让用户像结对编程一样观察智能体工作过程。
repos.summary_en: ColaMD is an Agent-Native Markdown editor designed for real-time collaboration between humans and AI agents. It instantly reflects AI-generated changes to .md files via file system monitoring, featuring WYSIWYG editing, cross-platform support, and theme customization—eliminating manual refresh cycles during agent-assisted writing.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents. Coming to Windows
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS GUI 工具，为 Mole CLI 提供可视化操作界面。它集成了磁盘清理、应用卸载、系统优化、磁盘分析及实时状态监控功能，并支持长期历史记录与本地 MCP 服务器，方便 AI 智能体通过自然语言直接操控系统维护任务，即将支持 Windows 平台。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS GUI for the Mole CLI engine. It bundles disk cleaning, app uninstallation, system optimization, disk analysis, and live status monitoring. Featuring long-range history and a local MCP server, it enables AI agents to autonomously diagnose and resolve system issues via natural language, with a Windows version in preview.

repos.description: Awesome AI GPTs, OpenAI GPTs, GPT-4, ChatGPT, GPTs, Prompts, plugins, Prompts leaking
repos.summary_zh: Awesome AI GPTs 是一个精选的 OpenAI GPTs 资源库，涵盖提示词工程、内容创作、编程辅助、数据分析等场景。项目提供热门 GPTs 推荐、插件安装指南、知识库构建工具及安全防护方案，助力用户高效利用 AI 能力。
repos.summary_en: Awesome AI GPTs is a curated collection of OpenAI GPTs resources, covering prompt engineering, content creation, coding assistance, and data analysis. It offers hot GPTs recommendations, plugin installation guides, knowledge base tools, and security solutions to enhance AI utilization.

repos.description: 归藏的材质插画 skill：生成带字解释图、图表美化和参考辅助配图。
repos.summary_zh: 歸藏的材质插画 Skill 是专为 AI Agent（如 Claude Code/Codex）设计的配图工具，核心解决文章、PPT 及社交卡片中“中心配图”的生成难题。它通过材质化 3D 风格，将抽象概念、数据图表及工作流程转化为带中文标签的解释图、美化图表及参考辅助图，强调信息传达的准确性与视觉的专业性，适配从小红书卡片到教学材料的多种场景。
repos.summary_en: Guizang Material Illustration Skill is an AI Agent-native tool for generating explanatory center graphics. It transforms abstract concepts, data charts, and workflows into labeled 3D material-style illustrations, beautified charts, and reference-assisted visuals. Focusing on information accuracy and Swiss editorial aesthetics, it supports various scenarios from social media cards to educational content.

repos.description: 一款完全开源的微信公众号文章获取、RSS 订阅 API 服务，支持整号文章一键导出 7 种格式（Markdown/HTML/Word/PDF/EPUB/Excel/JSON）、IP 代理池反风控、MCP 接入各种 AI Agent 工具。
repos.summary_zh: 完全开源的微信公众号文章获取与RSS订阅API服务，支持Chrome TLS指纹模拟、SOCKS5代理池反风控，提供公众号搜索、文章抓取、图片代理及Webhook通知功能。基于FastAPI构建，支持Docker一键部署和多架构兼容，本地扫码登录即可使用。
repos.summary_en: Fully open-source WeChat public account article fetching and RSS subscription API service with Chrome TLS fingerprint simulation, SOCKS5 proxy pool anti-detection, supporting account search, article scraping, image proxy, and webhook notifications. Built on FastAPI, Docker-deployable across multiple architectures, accessible via local QR login.

repos.description: Spec-driven development workflow for AI coding agents: architecture-first planning, task decomposition, GitHub Issue/PR tracking, Deep Discuss, and adaptive control for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other Markdown-capable agents.
repos.summary_zh: Spec-Driven Develop 是一个平台无关的 AI 代理技能，通过单个 `SKILL.md` 文件为大规模复杂任务提供全流程预开发自动化。它不依赖框架或运行时，而是以纯 Markdown 结构化指令驱动代理完成项目分析、任务拆解、进度跟踪和迭代开发，实现轻量级但高度可控的开发方法论。
repos.summary_en: Spec-Driven Develop is a platform-agnostic AI agent skill that automates pre-development workflows via a single SKILL.md file. It enables any coding agent to execute structured methodologies—including project analysis, task decomposition, and progress tracking—without frameworks or runtime dependencies, offering lightweight yet powerful automation for complex tasks.

repos.description: A verified, community-maintained catalog of 981 open-source projects built with Jev.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Jev 是社区维护的开源项目目录，收录 640 个基于 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的类型决策模型）构建的项目，涵盖 SDK、AI 智能体工具、浏览器自动化、游戏模拟等 11 个类别。每个条目均标注具体决策点及可验证的公开证据，帮助开发者快速发现并评估真实参考实现。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Jev is a community-maintained catalog of 640 open-source projects built with Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One model for typed decisions in software. Spanning 11 categories across SDKs, agent tooling, browser automation, games, and more, each entry identifies concrete decision points and links to verifiable public evidence for evaluating real implementations.

repos.summary_zh: VSC社区维护的Codex Skills集合，聚焦AIGC创作与视觉工作流。提供提示词工程、稀有风格探索、东方神话插画、抓拍人像摄影及虚拟Vlog生成等技能封装，支持一键安装至Codex并通过$skill-name调用，辅助创作者高效复用创意方法与管理生成资产。
repos.summary_en: A community-maintained collection of Codex Skills focused on AIGC creation and visual workflows. Covers prompt engineering, rare style exploration, Eastern mythology illustration, candid photography prompts, and virtual vlog generation. Skills are installed into Codex and invoked via $skill-name for efficient creative reuse and asset management.

repos.description: Give AI coding agents eyes. Records browser sessions, captures screenshots, collects errors, and bundles proof artifacts — so humans can verify what the agent built.
repos.summary_zh: ProofShot 是一个开源 CLI 工具，专为 AI 编程代理设计，提供视觉验证能力。它通过录制浏览器操作视频、捕获关键截图和系统日志，帮助 AI 代理在无头环境中验证 UI 功能是否正确实现。支持与 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等主流 AI 开发工具集成，自动生成可交互的验证报告，并将结果上传至 GitHub PR，实现端到端的自动化测试闭环。
repos.summary_en: ProofShot is an open-source, agent-agnostic CLI tool that gives AI coding agents visual verification capabilities. It records browser session videos, captures screenshots, and collects console/server logs to validate UI functionality in headless environments. Integrated with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, it auto-generates interactive reports and uploads results to GitHub PRs for seamless human review.

repos.summary_zh: PPT Agent 是一个基于多智能体协作的自动化幻灯片生成系统，支持跨平台运行。通过 LLM 生成内容 + Gemini 质量审查的双阶段流程，输出符合 Bento Grid 布局的 SVG 格式演示文稿（1280×720），涵盖从需求调研到最终交付的全流程自动化，适用于品牌发布会、产品推介等场景。
repos.summary_en: PPT Agent is a cross-platform multi-agent workflow for automated presentation generation. It combines LLM content creation with Gemini-powered quality review to produce SVG-based slides (1280×720) in Bento Grid layout, featuring end-to-end automation from requirement analysis to final delivery for use cases like product launches and business presentations.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2026] MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research · 浏览器里运行的安卓模拟器 · Browser-hosted Android Simulator · Verifiable Evaluation · Scalable Online RL Training
repos.summary_zh: MobileGym 是一个基于浏览器的可验证、高并行移动 GUI Agent 研究仿真平台。它提供 28 个模拟应用和 416 个参数化任务模板，支持确定性亚毫秒级评测，单服务器可并行运行 256 个实例，并通过 Sim-to-Real 验证实现 +40.7 分真实设备性能提升。
repos.summary_en: MobileGym is a browser-hosted, verifiable and highly parallel simulation platform for mobile GUI agent research. It ships 28 simulated apps with 416 parameterized task templates, deterministic sub-millisecond judges, 256 parallel instances per server, and achieves +40.7 pt sim-to-real transfer on real devices.

repos.description: Canonical source and governance toolkit for Zhijian AI public Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Zhijian Skills 是 OpenAI Codex Agent 的官方技能分发仓库，提供19个专注于 Codex 操作、工作流编排、模型推理与知识系统的即插即用技能包。支持通过 npx 一行命令快速安装，涵盖模型路由、上下文诊断、跨 Agent 交接、企业数字孪生、长文写作等场景。
repos.summary_en: Zhijian Skills is the canonical distribution repository for OpenAI Codex Agent Skills, offering 19 plug-and-play modules covering workflow orchestration, model routing, context diagnosis, cross-agent handoff, enterprise digital twins, and long-form writing. Install via a single npx command, with independently verified releases and complete payloads.

repos.description: AI generate code
repos.summary_zh: needware.dev 是一个开源的 AI 驱动全栈开发平台，支持在浏览器中直接生成、预览和部署 Web 应用。通过多智能体系统，可将文本描述、截图或 URL 转化为完整代码，集成 Supabase 数据库、实时预览和代码编辑器，实现从想法到产品的全流程开发。
repos.summary_en: needware.dev is an open-source AI-powered full-stack development platform that generates, previews, and deploys web applications directly in the browser. It leverages a multi-agent system to transform text, screenshots, or URLs into functional code, with integrated Supabase database, real-time preview, and code editor for end-to-end development.

repos.description: QuietHarness：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 共用的轻量 AI 工作系统
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个经过实战检验的 Claude Code 工作流模板，提供内存管理、上下文工程和任务路由三大核心能力。基于3个月多项目日常使用经验构建，采用三层架构设计：常驻规则层、按需文档层和热数据工作区，实现智能持久化开发伙伴。支持多模型分级路由、自动保存进度、强制验证完成状态，显著提升开发效率与代码质量。
repos.summary_en: A battle-tested Claude Code workflow template featuring memory management, context engineering, and task routing from 3 months of daily usage. Implements a three-layer architecture: always-loaded rules, on-demand docs, and hot working memory. Enables persistent, self-improving development with multi-model routing, auto-save, verification gates, and cross-session task tracking for production-ready workflows.

repos.description: A minimal modern terminal for AI coding experience — Sidebar workspaces; horizontal / vertical split panes; one-click agent launch; per-agent activity readout; live workspace state with one-click Node and branch switching.
repos.summary_zh: kooky 是一款专为 AI 编码打造的现代化 macOS 终端模拟器，基于 libghostty 实现 GPU 渲染。核心特性包括侧边栏工作区、多窗格分屏、一键启动 Claude Code/Gemini CLI 等多种 AI Agent、Git Worktree 隔离开发、右键选中内容直接询问 Agent、模糊快速打开面板以及多行提示词编辑器。支持会话自动恢复、跨窗口拖拽标签页，无账号无遥测，状态完全本地存储。
repos.summary_en: kooky is a minimal modern terminal emulator built for AI coding on macOS, powered by libghostty with GPU rendering. Key features include sidebar workspaces, horizontal/vertical split panes, one-click launch of Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other AI agents, Git Worktree isolation, right-click-to-ask-agent on selections, fuzzy Quick Open panel, and a multi-line prompt composer. Sessions auto-resume across restarts, tabs are draggable across panes and windows, and all state stays local with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.description: Agent skill that draws architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as hand-placed SVG, to one linted house style.
repos.summary_zh: SVG 手绘风格架构图绘制技能，为 AI 编码代理提供统一的布局算术、颜色系统与零依赖校验器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 40+ 代理，确保生成的序列图、数据流图、生命周期图经 svg-lint 12 项检查后保持 house 样式一致。
repos.summary_en: An agent skill that draws hand-crafted SVG diagrams — architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle — following a unified house style with layout arithmetic, a color system, and a zero-dependency linter (svg-lint) with 12 checks. Works with 40+ AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

repos.description: A fast, native RSS reader — plus an agent-facing CLI so your AI agent can read, search and triage your feeds from the shell.
repos.summary_zh: Papr 是一款专为桌面端设计的快速原生 RSS 阅读器，支持订阅管理、智能分类、全文抓取、AI 摘要与问答、音频播放及 FreshRSS 同步，数据本地存储于 SQLite，无云端依赖，提供多语言界面。
repos.summary_en: Papr is a fast, native desktop RSS reader featuring feed organization, smart views, full-text fetching, AI-powered summaries and Q&A, audio playback, FreshRSS sync, and local-first data storage via SQLite—no cloud or account required.

repos.description: Independent iOS client for Lody — native chat, sessions, and coding-agent collaboration on iPhone
repos.summary_zh: 独立开源 iOS 客户端，为 Lody AI 协作平台打造。采用 React Native + Swift 6.0 混合架构，结合 CRDT 数据同步，支持无限聊天、流式文本渲染、代码 Diff 高亮与文件树导航，严格遵循 Apple HIG，提供安全的本地会话与远程服务桥接体验。
repos.summary_en: Independent open-source iOS client for Lody AI platform. Hybrid React Native + Swift 6.0 architecture with CRDT sync (Loro/Flock). Features infinite chat, streaming rendering, code diff highlighting, and file tree. Strictly follows Apple HIG for authentic native experience bridging local sessions and remote services.

repos.description: Pi — A cross-platform AI coding agent, bringing the Claude Code experience to your desktop. No environment setup, no terminal commands. Download and start coding right away.
repos.summary_zh: Pi Agent 是一款跨平台 AI 编码代理桌面应用，将 Claude Code 能力封装为免配置的一体化安装包。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，无需终端命令即可直接与 AI 助手协作编程。提供会话管理、模型配置、代码预览和自动更新等功能。
repos.summary_en: Pi Agent is a cross-platform AI coding agent desktop app that packages Claude Code capabilities into a standalone, zero-config application. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it enables seamless AI-assisted development without terminal commands. Features include session management, model configuration, code preview, and automatic updates.

repos.description: 🏯 Claude Code / Codex skill — transform Chinese architecture, cultural places & travel photos into art-directed editorial posters with GPT Image. 中国古建筑与在地文化照片 → 艺术指导海报
repos.summary_zh: Yingzao 是将中国古建筑、文化场所与旅行照片转为艺术指导编辑海报的 Agent Skill。它通过构图识别、中式排版设计与图像重绘，保护建筑身份锚点，实现文字与主体的深度互动，支持多图融合与视频分镜扩展。
repos.summary_en: Yingzao is an agent skill that transforms Chinese architectural and cultural photos into art-directed editorial posters. It combines composition analysis, Chinese typography design, and image model generation to preserve architectural identity while creating meaningful text-image interactions, with support for multi-image fusion and video storyboard extension.

repos.description: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI Agent frame.
repos.summary_zh: Aser 是一个轻量级、自组装的 AI 智能体框架，支持模块化组合与快速开发。通过几行代码即可构建具备工具调用、知识库、记忆、MCP 协议等能力的智能体，适用于 Web3、自动化任务和多智能体协作场景，提供丰富的示例与扩展能力。
repos.summary_en: Aser is a lightweight, self-assembling AI agent framework enabling rapid development of modular agents. With just a few lines of code, users can build agents with tools, knowledge retrieval, memory, MCP protocol, and more, ideal for Web3 automation, multi-agent collaboration, and advanced AI workflows.

repos.description: Agent-Native Terminal
repos.summary_zh: Termany 是一款 Agent-Native 终端，采用本地优先、云端就绪的架构。通过统一的 React 与 xterm.js 界面，支持 Web、桌面（Tauri）及未来云端部署。核心亮点在于无缝集成 Claude、Codex 等十余种主流 AI 编码代理，支持分屏多任务、文件树内嵌编辑与预览，并提供详细的 AI 使用成本与 Token 消耗分析面板。
repos.summary_en: Termany is an agent-native terminal with a local-first, cloud-ready architecture. It unifies Web, desktop (Tauri), and future cloud deployments under a single React and xterm.js UI. Key features include seamless integration of over a dozen AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, etc.), split-pane multitasking, inline file editing/preview, and a detailed dashboard for tracking AI usage costs and token consumption.

repos.description: Agent Skill for Chinese-first HyperFrames motion-video production from articles, products, websites, and README files.
repos.summary_zh: HyperFrames Motion Director 是一款专为中文场景优化的 AI Agent 技能，旨在将文章、产品文档或 README 快速转化为 9:16 竖版动态视频。它采用两阶段工作流（先确认创意提案，再生成素材与合成），通过严格的布局契约与动效引导，确保输出符合专业标准的宣传片与文字动画。
repos.summary_en: HyperFrames Motion Director is an AI Agent skill optimized for Chinese-first workflows, transforming articles, product docs, or READMEs into 9:16 vertical motion videos. Utilizing a two-phase pipeline (brief confirmation followed by asset generation and composition), it enforces strict layout contracts and attention-guiding animations to produce professional kinetic typography and promotional content.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的多平台AI写作助手，提供从选题、创作到审校的全流程自动化工作流。通过个人素材库学习作者风格，采用三遍审校机制降低AI味至15-20%，集成标题优化、配图Prompt生成等功能，支持微信公众号、Twitter、小红书等多平台内容适配。
repos.summary_en: A multi-platform AI writing agent built on Claude Sonnet 4.5, offering end-to-end automation from ideation to publication. Features style learning via personal material library, three-round editing to reduce AI flavor to 15-20%, and integrated title optimization with image prompt generation, supporting content adaptation across WeChat, Twitter, Xiaohongshu and other platforms.

repos.description: Persistent, provider-neutral memory for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and MCP coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: PAXM 是一款专为 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code 等）设计的持久化、跨厂商记忆系统。它通过本地 SQLite 存储项目决策、架构规范与上下文，实现不同会话和不同代理间的知识无缝流转，解决每次新会话需重复解释项目背景的问题，且支持灵活切换 Zep、Mem0 等外部记忆存储提供商。
repos.summary_en: PAXM is a persistent, provider-neutral memory system designed for AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code. It stores project decisions, conventions, and context locally via SQLite, enabling seamless knowledge transfer across different sessions and agents. It eliminates the need to re-explain project backgrounds and supports flexible switching between storage backends like Zep and Mem0.

repos.description: WeSight Obsidian plugin for local agent runtimes.
repos.summary_zh: WeSight Obsidian 插件将 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等本地 AI 代理集成至 Obsidian 笔记系统，提供侧边栏聊天、内联编辑、文件引用与斜杠命令等功能。支持互联网快照分享、飞书文档同步及微信公众号草稿发布，实现 AI 协作与多平台内容分发的无缝衔接。
repos.summary_en: WeSight Obsidian plugin integrates local AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode directly into your Obsidian vault. Features include sidebar chat, inline editing, file mentions, and slash commands. It supports internet snapshot sharing, Feishu document sync, and WeChat Official Account draft publishing, enabling seamless AI collaboration and multi-platform content distribution.

repos.description: Browser-Use Desktop app, control your local Chrome browser with AI agents!
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use Desktop 是一款基于 Electron 和 Gradio 的桌面应用，通过 AI 智能体控制本地 Chrome 浏览器，实现网页自动化操作。支持多模态 LLM（如 OpenAI、Google、Anthropic 等）和自定义浏览器配置，无需重新登录网站，支持高清屏幕录制，适用于网页抓取、自动化测试等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use Desktop is an Electron-based desktop app that enables AI agents to control your local Chrome browser via Gradio UI. It supports multiple LLMs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, etc.), custom browser profiles, and high-definition screen recording, eliminating re-authentication issues and ideal for web automation and scraping tasks.

repos.description: 让 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI Agent 成为你的跨平台电脑维修助手：64 个按需加载的 Playbook，覆盖诊断、清理、性能、网络与安全维护——C 盘爆满、电脑卡顿、流氓软件、应用迁移、数据恢复都能直接问；先取证、再计划，确认后修改。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个面向AI Agent的跨平台电脑维修Skill，提供64个按需加载的Playbook，覆盖Windows/macOS/Linux的诊断、清理、性能优化、网络与安全维护。采用
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform computer repair Skill for AI Agents, featuring 64 on-demand Playbooks covering Windows, macOS, and Linux diagnostics, cleanup, performance optimization, and security maintenance. Follows an evidence-first, plan-confirm-modify workflow for natural language-based PC troubleshooting.

repos.description: Any Agent × Any Provider × Anywhere. Connect Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex to Slack, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat — with any LLM provider.
repos.summary_zh: GolemBot 是一个革命性工具，允许将 Cursor、Claude Code、OpenCode 或 Codex 等任意 AI 编程代理与任何 LLM 提供商集成，并部署到即时通讯（IM）、HTTP 接口或自有产品中。它通过单一配置实现跨平台运行，无需修改代码或依赖特定 AI 框架，支持 13,000+ OpenClaw 社区技能，极大扩展了 AI 代理的应用场景。
repos.summary_en: GolemBot enables running any coding agent (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) with any LLM provider and deploying it to IM platforms, HTTP endpoints, or custom products. It requires zero code changes, supports 13,000+ OpenClaw community skills, and integrates seamlessly via configuration—no AI framework dependency.

repos.description: 影子作家 · 为角色建立可复用的写作与语言特征模型，让 AI 稳定地「像某个人」说话。Python / Agent Skill 双形态。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目'ghostwriter'（影子作家）提供多来源语言特征JSON数据集，涵盖微博、文学影视角色及历史人物，支持非商业用途研究。采用CC BY-NC-ND 4.0许可，结合长上下文大模型可显著提升文本生成风格拟合度，适用于AI角色模拟与语言分析。
repos.summary_en: The 'ghostwriter' project provides structured linguistic feature datasets in JSON format, covering sources like Weibo, literary characters, and historical figures. Licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for non-commercial use, it enhances AI text generation when combined with large language models featuring long context capabilities, ideal for character simulation and stylistic analysis.

repos.description: Agent Skills for theming AI desktop apps: reference image → reversible Codex/WorkBuddy skin → verify, repair, publish. | 给 AI 桌面应用换肤的 Agent Skills：参考图 → 可逆皮肤 → 验证、修复、发布。
repos.summary_zh: CodeDrobe Skills 是一个开源的 AI 桌面应用主题生成与管理系统，专为 OpenAI Codex 和腾讯 WorkBuddy 等基于 Chromium/Electron 的 AI 桌面端提供可逆的主题定制方案。它通过 AI 技能（Skill）驱动，支持 DOM 快照分析、语义化主题生成与跨平台应用，极大简化了 AI 桌面环境的个性化与视觉管理。
repos.summary_en: CodeDrobe Skills is an open-source AI-driven theming engine for Chromium/Electron-based AI desktop apps like OpenAI Codex and Tencent WorkBuddy. It provides a reversible theme customization workflow utilizing DOM snapshot analysis and semantic generation. Managed via installable Agent Skills, it simplifies visual personalization and cross-platform theme deployment for AI desktop environments.

repos.summary_zh: 刘聪 NLP 的 Agent Skill 仓库，提供可复用的提示工程模块。核心包含三渲二动画短片提示词生成（覆盖剧情、角色、Midjourney 故事板与 Seedance 视频提示）与微信公众号标题策略分析（多风格生成、评分及风险检查）。通过软链接安装实现热更新，专为 AI Agent 平台设计，大幅提升内容创作自动化效率。
repos.summary_en: A repository of reusable Agent Skills for NLP tasks by Liucong. It features a 3D-to-2D animation prompt generator (covering storyboards for Midjourney and Seedance) and a WeChat public account title strategist (multi-style generation, scoring, and risk checking). Designed for AI Agent platforms with hot-reload support via symlinks, it significantly boosts content creation automation.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级、专注国产生态的 AI 助手框架，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、通义千问等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供统一的 Function Calling 能力。它原生集成 QQ、飞书、钉钉、企业微信等通讯平台适配器，内置 25 个工具（文件操作、浏览器自动化、定时任务等）、记忆系统、Skills 技能扩展机制，以及智能上下文压缩策略，适用于企业内部机器人和团队协作场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework focused on the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, and Qwen via unified OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible interfaces with native Function Calling. It integrates adapters for QQ, Feishu, DingTalk, and WeCom, featuring 25 built-in tools (file ops, browser automation, cron jobs), memory system, Skills extension via SKILL.md, and intelligent context compression—ideal for enterprise bots and team collaboration.

repos.description: Professional SEO and GEO audit workflows for brands, SaaS teams, SEO operators, agencies, and AI-search growth teams.
repos.summary_zh: SEO GEO Audit 是一个统一的网站审计框架，专为品牌、SaaS团队、SEO运营者、代理机构和AI搜索增长团队设计。它将技术健康度、内容质量、EEAT（经验、专业性、权威性、可信度）、实体信号和AI可见性整合为可执行决策框架，解决传统SEO检查表无法回答的‘网站是否真正准备好在搜索引擎和AI驱动发现中获胜’的核心问题。
repos.summary_en: SEO GEO Audit is a unified audit framework for teams needing more than basic technical SEO checks. It diagnoses whether a website is technically sound, structurally clear, trustworthy, AI-packaged, externally visible, and aligned with multiple AI platforms. Instead of fragmented findings, it delivers a prioritized decision framework covering technical health, content quality, EEAT, entity signals, authority, and off-site visibility to answer the critical question: Is this site ready to win in both search engines and AI-driven discovery?

repos.description: Git worktree-based task manager with integrated terminals for CLI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Ouijit 是一款基于 Git worktree 的 AI 编程代理任务管理器，集成终端会话、生命周期钩子与脚本系统，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等代理工具。提供看板式任务管理、自动并行工作流、实时代理状态通知、VM 沙箱隔离及会话恢复等功能，无需账号、无遥测，专为 AI 辅助开发流程打造。
repos.summary_en: Ouijit is a Git worktree-based task and terminal session manager designed for AI coding agents. It integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and other agent CLIs via lifecycle hooks, scripts, and a session-aware CLI. Features include kanban task management, automatic parallel workstreams, live agent status with notifications, VM sandboxing for untrusted code, and session resumption—fully open-source with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.summary_zh: Content Signal Radar 是一个基于 GitHub Actions 的自动化信号情报系统，从 X、博客、播客、即刻、公众号等多源抓取信息，通过去重、评分和噪声过滤，生成结构化信号报告。它不是新闻摘要，而是面向内容创作者和产品决策者的决策辅助系统，输出可直接用于 X 推文草稿、小红书选题或产品洞察，支持 Telegram 推送和仪表盘集成。
repos.summary_en: Content Signal Radar is an automated signal intelligence system powered by GitHub Actions. It ingests feeds from X, blogs, podcasts, Jike, and WeChat public accounts, then deduplicates, scores, and filters noise to produce structured signal reports. Designed for content creators and product decision-makers, it generates actionable outputs—X drafts, Xiaohongshu angles, and product signals—deliverable via stdout, Telegram, or dashboard integration.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级 AI 助手框架，专为国产生态设计，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、Qwen 等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供飞书、钉钉、QQ、企业微信等多平台机器人接入，具备 Function Calling、25 个内置工具、记忆系统、定时任务等核心功能，代码简洁（约1.6万行），适合学习 Agent 原理和快速开发企业级智能助手。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework designed for the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It offers multi-platform bot integration (Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom), native Function Calling, 25 built-in tools, memory system, cron jobs, and a skill-based architecture. With ~16K lines of clean code, it's ideal for learning agent principles and rapid development of enterprise-grade AI assistants.

repos.description: One Page Agent.The browser-native workbench that lives in One Page.
repos.summary_zh: OnePagent 是一款单文件部署的浏览器原生 AI 智能体工作台，仅需一个 HTML 文件即可实现多轮对话、工具调用、Python 沙箱、网络搜索及长期记忆等全功能。支持多 LLM 提供商、MCP 服务器集成与子代理协作，无需后端或构建工具，开箱即用。
repos.summary_en: OnePagent is a single-file, browser-native AI agent workbench delivering full functionality—multi-turn chat, tool calls, Python sandbox, web search, and long-term memory—in one HTML file. It supports multi-provider LLMs, MCP server integration, and sub-agent collaboration with zero backend or build dependencies.

repos.description: A carefully curated list of awesome OpenClaw resources — not everything, just the best.  Skills · Plugins · MCP · Tools · Deployments · Security · Research · Alternatives。精心策划的 OpenClaw 优质资源大合集 —— 不求大而全，只求真有用。
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 是一个精心策划的优质资源合集，聚焦于本地优先、自主运行的 AI 智能体框架。涵盖技能插件、MCP集成、部署方案、安全实践及替代工具，旨在提供实用而非泛化的技术指南，帮助用户快速构建和运行自主 AI 代理。
repos.summary_en: Awesome OpenClaw is a meticulously curated collection of top-tier resources for the OpenClaw autonomous AI agent framework. It covers skills, plugins, MCP integrations, deployments, security, and alternatives, focusing on practicality over exhaustiveness to empower developers in building local-first, self-hosted AI agents.

repos.description: Bird is a cli for twitter, so your agents can tweet.
repos.summary_zh: Bird 是一款基于命令行界面的 X (Twitter) 客户端，专为自动化脚本和 AI 智能体设计。它支持通过浏览器 Cookie 或 Sweetistics API 进行身份验证，提供发推、回复、读取推文、搜索及查看提及等核心功能，并支持 JSON 格式输出，便于集成到自动化工作流中。
repos.summary_en: Bird is a fast command-line interface for X (Twitter), designed for automation scripts and AI agents. It supports authentication via browser cookies or the Sweetistics API, offering core functionalities like tweeting, replying, reading, searching, and viewing mentions. It also supports JSON output for seamless integration into automated workflows.

repos.summary_zh: 10xagent 是一个极简的 AI Agent 原型，仅用 10 行 JavaScript 代码实现了基于 for 循环、工具调用与 LLM 的自进化 Harness。通过 30-50 轮迭代，Agent 能自主优化代码、执行 Bash 命令并验证结果，展示了 AI 自我进化的核心原理。
repos.summary_en: 10xagent is a minimal AI Agent prototype that implements a self-evolving harness using just 10 lines of JavaScript code with for-loop, tool calling, and LLM. Through 30-50 iterations, the agent autonomously optimizes code, executes Bash commands, and verifies results, demonstrating the core principles of AI self-evolution.

repos.description: Local-first desktop API client built for developers and AI agents
repos.summary_zh: Voleeo 是一款面向 AI 时代的本地优先桌面 API 客户端，原生支持 HTTP、gRPC、WebSocket 和 GraphQL 四大协议。内置 MCP Server，允许 AI 智能体直接读写工作区、发起请求与管理环境。具备 AES-256-GCM 加密、OAuth 2.0 等全链路认证、Git 版本控制、OpenAPI/Postman 导入及插件扩展能力，零遥测、无云端锁定。
repos.summary_en: Voleeo is a local-first desktop API client built for the AI era, natively supporting HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, and GraphQL in a single app. It doubles as an MCP server, enabling AI agents to read, create, and execute requests directly from chat. Features include AES-256-GCM encryption, full auth suites (OAuth 2.0, SigV4, etc.), Git-based collection versioning, OpenAPI/Postman imports, plugin extensibility, and zero telemetry with no cloud lock-in.

repos.description: A self-hosted MCP relay for native coding runtimes
repos.summary_zh: Agenvo是一个自托管的MCP中继服务，将ChatGPT、Grok Bot等AI助手与运行在本地电脑和服务器的编码代理（如Codex、Herdr）无缝连接。用户可通过AI助手跨设备统一调度、监控和续接编码任务，无需开放入站端口，支持Agent自行重连恢复工作。
repos.summary_en: Agenvo is a self-hosted MCP relay that bridges AI assistants (ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse) with native coding runtimes (Codex, Herdr) on your computers and servers. It enables cross-device agent coordination via WSS connections without inbound ports, letting AI assistants monitor, manage, and resume coding tasks seamlessly.

repos.description: Story-first Agent Skill for creating, routing, and QA-checking PPT, HTML, and image-first presentation decks
repos.summary_zh: Knowledge Cat PPT Skill 是一款专为 AI 智能体（如 Codex、Claude Code）设计的演示文稿生产系统。它采用“故事优先”理念，通过受众分析、叙事构建和多通道路由（原生可编辑 PPTX、HTML 演示、图像优先 PPTX），将零散素材转化为结构化演示。系统集成了严格的 JSON 与 HTML 校验器、证据追踪机制及 44 种风格模板库，确保从大纲规划到最终渲染 QA 的全流程专业性与高可用性。
repos.summary_en: Knowledge Cat PPT Skill is a story-first presentation production system for AI agents like Codex and Claude Code. It transforms rough ideas into structured decks through audience analysis, narrative planning, and multi-lane routing (Native PPTX, HTML, Image-first). Featuring strict validators, evidence tracking, and a 44-style template library, it ensures professional quality from planning to rendered QA.

repos.description: Core library for Cola. Provides essential capabilities commonly used by agents.
repos.summary_zh: coli 是 Cola 项目的核心库，为 AI 智能体提供语音识别（ASR）、文本转语音（TTS）及云端 TTS 等基础能力。支持本地模型与 ListenHub OpenAPI 集成，具备流式 ASR 和 macOS 专用 TTS 功能，适用于构建语音交互应用。
repos.summary_en: Coli is the core library for the Cola project, delivering essential capabilities like automatic speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), and cloud-based TTS via ListenHub OpenAPI for AI agents. It supports local models, streaming ASR, and macOS-exclusive TTS features, ideal for voice-enabled applications.

repos.description: A User-agent analyze project.
repos.summary_zh: useragent.js 是一个轻量级用户代理解析库，支持 Node.js、浏览器及经典 ASP 环境，可精准识别浏览器、操作系统和设备类型。提供结构化输出，包含名称、版本、平台及图标信息，兼容主流浏览器及 IE8+，适用于流量分析、设备适配等场景。
repos.summary_en: useragent.js is a lightweight user-agent parsing library supporting Node.js, browsers, and classic ASP environments. It accurately identifies browsers, operating systems, and device types, providing structured output with name, version, platform, and icon data. Compatible with major browsers and IE8+, ideal for traffic analysis and device adaptation.

repos.description: A skill for coding agents that build, review, and refactor Web UI that should be easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate.
repos.summary_zh: 为AI编码代理提供的Web UI设计技能，指导构建、审查与重构前端界面，使其对人类、屏幕阅读器、浏览器自动化、Playwright测试及AI代理更友好。核心聚焦语义HTML、清晰状态、稳定定位器与可复现URL模式，附带分级审查报告，助力提升前端可访问性与自动化兼容性。
repos.summary_en: A skill for coding agents to build, review, and refactor Web UI that is easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate. It focuses on semantic HTML, clear state, stable locators, and reproducible URL patterns, providing severity-graded review reports to enhance accessibility and automation compatibility.

repos.description: Your desktop AI agent, always ready
repos.summary_zh: TouchAI 是一款桌面端 AI 智能体工具，通过快捷键 Alt+Space 快速唤起，支持全键盘操作，不打断用户工作流。它能智能感知桌面上下文（文件、屏幕、剪贴板），内置 7 大工具并支持 MCP 协议扩展，采用 BYOK 模式允许用户自由切换 AI 提供商和模型，无厂商锁定。支持文件搜索、可视化交互界面及模型自升级功能，是提升桌面办公效率的 AI 自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: TouchAI is a desktop AI agent that can be instantly summoned via Alt+Space hotkey without interrupting workflow. It supports full keyboard operation and intelligently perceives desktop context including files, screen, and clipboard. With 7 built-in tools and MCP protocol extensibility, it adopts a BYOK model allowing users to freely switch between AI providers and models without vendor lock-in. Features include file search, visual interactive UI, and model self-upgrade.

repos.description: 一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记、本地知识库、AI 智能助手、向量语义检索 。
repos.summary_zh: OpenNote 是一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记管理、本地知识库构建、AI 智能助手及向量语义检索。具备长期记忆与自我进化能力，通过 MCP 协议与 AI 大模型深度集成，实现知识的高效组织与智能问答，适合个人知识管理与 AI 增强型笔记场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenNote is a cross-platform intelligent note-taking Agent application that supports multi-format note management, local knowledge base building, AI-powered assistance, and vector semantic search. With long-term memory and self-evolving capabilities, it integrates deeply with AI large language models via the MCP protocol, enabling efficient knowledge organization and intelligent Q&A for personal knowledge management and AI-enhanced note-taking scenarios.

repos.summary_zh: AI驱动的交互式需求澄清工具，通过引导式问答将模糊创意转化为结构化技术规格文档，支持SSE流式输出，可直接对接AI编码代理执行。
repos.summary_en: AI-powered interactive requirements refinement tool that transforms vague ideas into structured technical specs via guided Q&A, with SSE streaming and ready-to-execute output for AI coding agents.

repos.description: Turn an approved product design, PRD, prototype, design system, or architecture brief into an AI-governed, deployable full-stack project with a pnpm monorepo, requirement traceability, canonical multi-agent rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI, container deployment assets, and handoff evidence.
repos.summary_zh: 面向VibeCoding的Codex工程Skill，将产品设计与架构规范转化为可部署的全栈项目。采用pnpm monorepo架构，支持多Agent协同规则、AI审查、质量门禁与CI/CD流水线，Routine模式高效处理日常修复，Init模式负责标准化初始化。
repos.summary_en: A Codex engineering skill for VibeCoding that transforms product designs into deployable full-stack projects using pnpm monorepo. Supports multi-agent rules, AI review, quality gates, and CI/CD pipelines, with Routine mode for efficient daily fixes and Init mode for standardized project setup.

repos.description: Turn an approved product design, PRD, prototype, design system, or architecture brief into an AI-governed, deployable full-stack project with a pnpm monorepo, requirement traceability, canonical multi-agent rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI, container deployment assets, and handoff evidence.
repos.summary_zh: 面向 AI 辅助开发的工程 Skill，帮助 Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 将产品设计与架构方案转化为可部署的全栈项目。支持 pnpm monorepo、多 Agent 协作规则、强制 AI 审查、可执行质量门禁、CI 流水线及容器化部署资产，覆盖初始化、日常开发、仓库审计与发布准备等完整生命周期。
repos.summary_en: An engineering skill for AI-assisted development that helps Codex, Claude Code, and compatible agents transform product designs and architecture briefs into deployable full-stack projects. Supports pnpm monorepo, multi-agent collaboration rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI pipelines, and container deployment assets across initialization, daily development, audits, and release workflows.

repos.description: Self-hostable NGINX module that serves Markdown to AI agents via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), powered by a Rust converter.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个自托管的 NGINX 模块，通过 HTTP 内容协商（Accept: text/markdown）将 HTML 页面转换为 Markdown 格式供 AI 智能体读取。基于 Rust 构建，无需修改现有应用即可为浏览器返回原始 HTML，同时为支持 Markdown 的请求提供纯净内容，降低 AI 处理成本。
repos.summary_en: This project is a self-hostable NGINX module that converts HTML to Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) for AI agents, powered by a Rust converter. It serves clean Markdown only when requested while preserving original HTML for browsers, enabling seamless agent-friendly content delivery without application changes.

repos.description: A CLI/TUI tool to manage and switch tokens & base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex.
repos.summary_zh: agtok 是一个 CLI/TUI 工具，用于集中管理和切换 Claude、Gemini 和 Codex 等 AI 代理的令牌与基础 URL。支持交互式终端界面、预设分组、原子化写入与备份，适用于多环境 AI 工具配置管理。
repos.summary_en: agtok is a CLI/TUI tool for centrally managing and switching tokens and base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex. It supports interactive TUI, preset grouping, atomic writes with backups, and seamless configuration switching across environments.

repos.description: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
repos.summary_en: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.
